title: Near-perfect triangle packings from sum-zero triples
abstract: Records a reusable formalization byproduct accompanying Paper III: pairwise edge-disjoint triangles in any finite complete graph such that every vertex is incident to at most three uncovered edges, using a cyclic-group sum-zero triple system, with a bridge to Mathlib's SimpleGraph API.

informal.SumZeroTriangles.exists_simpleGraph_tria: For every finite vertex type, its complete simple graph has a family of pairwise edge-disjoint triangle graphs whose uncovered graph has degree at most three at every vertex.
informal.SumZeroTriangles.exists_triangle_packing: Every finite complete graph has a family of pairwise edge-disjoint triangles leaving uncovered degree at most three at every vertex.
